What does the evidence say about development interventions, and how sure can we be?
This site collects impact evaluations, extracts their results, checks every number
against the source, and pools them into meta-analyses that are updated as new
studies appear.

The first topic is **cash transfers**, with a focus on **Latin America**.

See [Methods](methods.qmd) for how studies are found, extracted and verified.
